top_signals.title: Labour donor vows to bankroll Rosebank judicial challenge
top_signals.summary: One of the Labour party’s most high-profile donors has vowed to bankroll a legal challenge against the government if it approves the Rosebank oilfield, despite just months ago throwing his weight behind the project. Green energy tycoon Dale Vince said he would help fund a judicial review of any decision by ministers to rubber stamp [...]
